scripts.dev: bun run --cwd ../../packages/shared build && bun run --cwd ../../packages/db build && bun --watch src/server.ts
scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../../packages/shared build && bun run --cwd ../../packages/db build && rm -rf dist && bun build src/server.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist --sourcemap=external
scripts.test: bun run --cwd ../../packages/shared build && bun run --cwd ../../packages/db build && bun test src
scripts.test:coverage: bun run --cwd ../../packages/shared build && bun run --cwd ../../packages/db build && bun test --coverage src
